lab.solution_code:
# --- Introduction to transformer models ---
import torch
from torch import nn

class TransformerModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_heads, num_layers, output_dim):
        super(TransformerModel, self).__init__()
        
        # Define the encoder layers
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=hidden_dim, nhead=num_heads)
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        
        # Define the input and output layers
        self.input_layer = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim)
    
    def forward(self, src):
        # Pass the input through the input layer
        src = self.input_layer(src)
        
        # Pass the input through the transformer encoder
        output = self.transformer_encoder(src)
        
        # Pass the output through the output layer
        output = self.output_layer(output)
        
        return output

# --- HetTransformer model ---
class HetTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_heads, num_layers, output_dim):
        super(HetTransformer, self).__init__()
        
        # Define the encoder layers
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=hidden_dim, nhead=num_heads)
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        
        # Define the input and output layers
        self.input_layer = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim)
    
    def forward(self, src):
        # Pass the input through the input layer
        src = self.input_layer(src)
        
        # Pass the input through the transformer encoder
        output = self.transformer_encoder(src)
        
        # Aggregate structural representation using a type-specific transformation matrix
        type_specific_matrix = torch.randn(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)  # Placeholder for actual implementation
        aggregated_output = torch.matmul(output, type_specific_matrix)
        
        # Pass the aggregated output through the output layer
        output = self.output_layer(aggregated_output)
        
        return output

# --- Encoder-decoder structure ---
class Encoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_heads, num_layers):
        super(Encoder, self).__init__()
        
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=hidden_dim, nhead=num_heads)
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
    
    def forward(self, src):
        output = self.transformer_encoder(src)
        return output

class Decoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim, output_dim, num_heads, num_layers):
        super(Decoder, self).__init__()
        
        decoder_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(d_model=hidden_dim, nhead=num_heads)
        self.transformer_decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(decoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim)
    
    def forward(self, tgt, memory):
        output = self.transformer_decoder(tgt, memory)
        output = self.output_layer(output)
        return output
